purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.success: Host numerical+structural qualification passes, then frozen device qualification passes without threshold relaxation or CPU fallback.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: ACTIVE: learned residual / wider multi-block or full-Vocos student / qualified-surrogate route after exact/equivalent recovery was closed by preregistered Stage2 validation.

L1_PHASE.goal: Learned host numerical recovery: build an intentional NPU-native correction/student that passes teacher/full-Vocos CPU, QNN-CPU, disjoint heldout/stress and eventually strict HTP gates. QNN CPU remains reference/integration control, not an HTP simulator.
L1_PHASE.exit_success: A frozen learned candidate passes host numerical + structural qualification, then proceed to strict HTP device truth.
L1_PHASE.exit_stall: If a single-boundary learned corrector cannot generalize on disjoint host heldout, enlarge optimization unit (adjacent blocks / wider student) rather than micro-tune rank or exact algebra.

L2_MECHANISM.name: BLOCK0_ADD3_LEARNED_RESIDUAL_FOUNDATION
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: Exact/equivalent routes are closed. Nonperturbing QNN taps show the final-sensitive direction is already present by block0 residual Add3, while full-graph attribution shows strong downstream amplification and compensating later intrinsic errors. A learned residual at a complete residual boundary can target the observed total QNN-CPU boundary error without requiring intermediate algebraic equivalence.
L2_MECHANISM.mechanism_budget: Foundation first: freeze train/validation/holdout split before reading the all-warm residual corpus; collect candidate-own ORT/QNN Add3 pairs; test whether the correction target has stable low-rank structure and heldout predictability. Do not choose rank from final spectrum or warm18.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: Residual target is predictably low-rank on disjoint validation/holdout, justifying one NPU-native low-rank correction candidate family with preregistered rank/regularization selection.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_failure: If Add3 residual is not stably learnable, escalate optimization unit to wider multi-block/full-Vocos student per preserved rev46 contingency instead of fitting harder on the same boundary.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Can `ORT Add3 - QNN Add3` on current host best be predicted from the QNN Add3 state with a compact low-rank linear correction that generalizes across disjoint real-warm blocks?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Freeze an outcome-independent 30/8/9 train/validation/holdout split over warm1..47 using input SHA; force warm18 into holdout. Use the already observer-qualified nonperturbing Add3 tap graph to collect all-warm QNN Add3 and candidate-own ORT Add3 once. Fit ridge reduced-rank regression only on train; select rank/regularization only on validation using Add3 residual metrics, never final spectrum; open holdout once after selection.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: Quantify singular spectrum, train/validation/holdout residual reduction, and stability. Only if heldout material improvement is robust may a source ONNX learned branch be materialized for QNN end-to-end testing.

L4_ACTION.action: Freeze the 30/8/9 warm split with warm18 in holdout, then collect all-warm current-best Add3 QNN/ORT taps using the already observer-qualified tap graph; do not fit until the split and dataset manifest are SHA-locked.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: This is the first intentional-student foundation step after exact-route closure. It tests learnability before committing to architecture search and keeps warm18 out of fitting/selection.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_every_scored_experiment: Re-evaluate L3 against L2 before choosing another action.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_family_closure: Return to L2; do not create a sibling family automatically.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_two_consecutive_nonmaterial_experi: Stop mechanism-level tuning and enlarge the optimization unit or route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.when_expected_leverage_is_small_relative: Do not micro-tune; justify broader learned capacity or change route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_single_boundary_learned_failure: Escalate to adjacent-block/wider student rather than more rank/regularization variants.
